newsitem.title: USA: Genentech says court approves settlement.
newsitem.headline: Genentech says court approves settlement.

text.p: Genentech Inc Thursday said a Delaware Chancery Court approved the settlement of a consolidated stockholder class action lawsuit related to the extended buyout option by Roche Holding Ltd .
The buyout option was approved by stockholders in October 1995.

Under the extended buyout option, Roche has the right to cause the redemption of the remaining Genentech stock it does not already own at a predetermined price that increases quarterly through the quarter beginning April 1, 1999.
The same transaction gives Genentech stockholders the right to "put" some or all of their stock at $60 per share within a 30 business-day period commencing July 1, 1999.

The company said in settlement of the lawsuits filed, Roche agreed to an increase in the redemption prices for Genentech's stock by $0.50 each quarter, with a final redemption price of $82.50, if Roche caused the redemption of the remaining Genentech stock. The settlement increases the current redemption price to $66.75 from $66.25.
